Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the non-employment hire reason name; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Affiliates such as observers and contractors need Oracle access but aren't paid. They're converted like other hires, with three settings that keep them out of payroll.

Use this whenSomeone needs access but isn't an employee and won't be paid.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Never use Active no payroll for someone who should be paid. They won't be.
  • Affiliates on campus need a background check but not an I-9.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: How You Convert Pending Workers (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1Which assignment status for an unpaid affiliate?

Q2New hire report for a contractor?

Q3Which hire reason?

4 · Job aid

Keep it handy.

A one-page version of the steps and watch-outs. Print it or save it as a PDF.

HCM Academy job aid · Hiring

Non-Workers

Use when: Someone needs access but isn't an employee and won't be paid. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Hire reason: Non-employment.
  2. Assignment status: Active no payroll.
  3. Work relationship: Exclude from the new hire report.

Watch-outs

  • Never use Active no payroll for someone who should be paid. They won't be.
  • Affiliates on campus need a background check but not an I-9.
